name: PhysicalParams
description: Bounded physical renderer settings shared by the simulator and firmware.

fields.label: Inner radius
fields.help: Radius of the liquid-facing vessel surface.

fields.label: Wall thickness
fields.help: Thickness of the glass or acrylic wall around the liquid.

fields.label: Liquid refractive index
fields.help: Refractive index used at the liquid interfaces.

fields.label: Wall refractive index
fields.help: Refractive index of the vessel wall material.

fields.label: Absorption red
fields.help: Beer-Lambert absorption coefficient for the red channel.

fields.label: Absorption green
fields.help: Beer-Lambert absorption coefficient for the green channel.

fields.label: Absorption blue
fields.help: Beer-Lambert absorption coefficient for the blue channel.

fields.label: Light angle
fields.help: Direction of the area light in the renderer view.

fields.label: Light size
fields.help: Angular size of the area light source.

fields.label: Light intensity
fields.help: Intensity multiplier for the area light.

fields.label: Ambient intensity
fields.help: Uniform environment fill before material attenuation.

fields.label: Backing reflectance
fields.help: Diffuse reflectance of the surface behind the vessel.

fields.label: Marks reflectance
fields.help: Reflectance of rear marks and tick surfaces.

fields.label: Exposure
fields.help: Display exposure applied after linear optical compositing.

fields.label: Hours layout Y
fields.help: Top pixel coordinate of the hours tube.

fields.label: Minutes layout Y
fields.help: Top pixel coordinate of the minutes tube.
